findings.advisory_level: the real artifact chose the gold hypothesis (infra, code, config) on every arm and every citation quote was verbatim in the evidence it was given — decisive relationships survive record selection
findings.strict_contract: every arm — compressed AND the uncompressed within-envelope packet — was refused by the shipped citation contract on byte offsets (quote_mismatch / offset_out_of_range); the model supplies verbatim quotes but cannot count bytes. The product path therefore escalates honestly (unresolved) for this artifact today, independent of compression
findings.benefit: for oversized evidence (framed 3736-4569 tokens vs the 2048 envelope), compression is the only path to investigation at all: deterministic-only refuses and escalates; compressed evidence fits (1941/1983 prompt tokens). For within-envelope evidence, compression has no benefit class (1778 bytes diagnose directly at 1165 prompt tokens; the product bypasses the classifier there)
findings.cost: compressor 3.9-4.6 s per packet (inside the 30 s caller budget), 3600-byte output, transient RSS under 1.7 GB returned after the run; diagnosis itself is CPU-bound (~225 s per arm on this host) — that latency belongs to the admitted-runtime work (#108), not the compressor
findings.residency: compressor ran on an idle worker, its working set returned before the investigator loaded (fresh admission snapshot); single-worker serialization contract exercised end to end

decision: compression stays off by default; proven input classes only (keyword-anchored decisive facts); enablement additionally blocked on the citation-offset contract decision (#139/#108 scope)
raw_outputs: captured in the run log; greedy (temperature 0), deterministic
